items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: P-Ron had really what you would call a society band... majority of the musicians always did look up to P-Ron's band

ctx.x: as of now. I just took that up to Tulane last week, I wish I'd kept it here. We could have played that for you.

I really couldn't remember but in that time, P-Ron had really what you would call a society band. It had a nice punch and majority of the musicians always did look up to P-Ron's band as being more of a cultured band. Yes, I know.

I know. You can tell some of that on the records too. Well with the violins, the featuring of the violin and everything too. It was more of a smooth, sweet band I guess. That's right. T.O. comes through quite a bit on some of those things too but otherwise you can't always tell so much about T.O.'s tone and all. I guess we might as well get on with your life now a little bit more. Maybe you can tell us a little bit more about T.O. too since he's also gone. Yeah, well. Just what style he played and how his tone…
